snippet.title: Bringing Space to Life | The Expanse: Osiris Reborn
snippet.description:
How to portray life in space in a sci-fi RPG in a way that would feel right? We at Owlcat Games invited Leroy Chiao, a former NASA astronaut, to consult us on both the scientific aspect and share his personal experience of living in space. 
We also did a lot of our own research, and you will be able to see the results of our collective labor in the upcoming Beta, if you are a Founder with a Miller's Pack or a Collector's Edition. Stay tuned for more news on development of The Expanse: Osiris Reborn!

Become a Founder: https://osirisreborn.owlcat.games/
($10 discount is already applied to all digital editions)
